name: u_splicetrans
notes: Phase transition splicer uses first and third harmonics (arg0) and requires phase in[0,1] plus its frequency. The supported dc stimulus holds the central phase0.5: subtract0.5 selects the centered transition-table zero, so output remains near0.5 after table construction. This checks both signal ports and a source-derived fixed point; spectral alias rejection of a moving phasor is not claimed because the agreed stimulus kinds lack phasor.
